================================================================================
METHODOLOGY
================================================================================
  S1 WIN/LOSS : TP or SL hit — no time limit — ONGOING if still open
  S2 WIN/LOSS : TP or SL hit — no time limit — ONGOING if still open
  S1 EMA: seeded with SMA(N), k=2/(N+1)  |  ADX: Wilder smoothing
  S2 MA44: simple SMA  |  ATR: Wilder  |  4H gate cached per 4h bucket
  Both strategies: SL/TP checked candle-by-candle from bar after entry
================================================================================
